slides.text:
RESEARCH
Key insights
Crypto users don’t know where to start, which created hesitation and abandonment.
Users felt blindsided when fees appeared only at the payment step. They described it as “being tricked at checkout.”
When things broke, support links were hidden or dead. “I needed help and got nowhere.”
Words like “network fee” and “gas” made people pause and second-guess.
People pasted addresses without realizing chain mismatch could lose funds.
Verification felt invasive and random when placed up front. First-time buyers called it “like asking for marriage on the first date.”
Long manual addresses on mobile caused fear of losing funds. Many users dropped after errors.
People did not know how long verification or delivery would take. Quotes like “am I stuck here forever?” came up often.
When SMS codes failed, users felt helpless. One said, “the app just gave up on me.”
